estimates.assumptions: Boneless skinless chicken breasts contain negligible carbohydrates.
Vinaigrette dressing carbohydrate content varies widely by brand/formula (oil-based assumed from prior estimate); no specific label data available to quantify total bottle accurately.
1½ tbsp cumin powder; standard values ~6g carbs and ~4.5g fiber per tbsp; scaled to 1.5 tbsp.
1 tbsp smoked paprika; standard values ~6g carbs and ~4g fiber per tbsp.
1 tsp minced garlic; standard values ~1g carbs per tsp.
1 standard 16oz/450g can refried beans; typical values ~10g carbs and ~3.3g fiber per 100g, scaled to full can.
12 standard hard corn taco shells (~13g each); typical values ~6g carbs and ~0.75g fiber per shell, scaled to 12.
2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend (~240g); typical values ~3-4g carbs per 100g with negligible fiber.
~200g halved grape tomatoes; standard values ~4g carbs and ~1.5g fiber per 100g, scaled to full amount.
~30g sliced and seeded jalapeño; standard values ~7g carbs and ~3g fiber per 100g, scaled to full amount.
1 large avocado (~200g peeled); standard values ~8.5g carbs and ~6.7g fiber per 100g, scaled to full amount.
2 tbsp green salsa; typical values ~1g carbs per tbsp with negligible fiber.
3 tbsp sour cream (~45g); typical values ~4g carbs per 100g with negligible fiber.
1 tbsp milk (~15g); standard values ~5g carbs per 100g, scaled to full amount.
